developer-tooling.title: Fix Windows-only crash in adapter timeout kill path
developer-tooling.description: Adapter._kill_group references signal.SIGKILL unconditionally, which does not exist on Windows, so any adapter timeout raises AttributeError from the cleanup path instead of stopping the analyzer. Windows also lacks os.setsid and os.killpg, so the process-group guarantee the timeout depends on has no implementation there.
acceptance_criteria: an adapter timeout on Windows terminates the analyzer and its descendants instead of raising AttributeError

documentation.title: Record the six landed bundle commits in CHANGELOG and project-context
documentation.description: Commits 8775017 through 54f9a13 landed from an offline bundle and are on origin/main, but CHANGELOG.md has no entry for any of them and .ai/project-context.md has no section. They change probes, packs, gates, scoring and the CLI surface, which the changelog policy requires to be recorded. Entries must be written from the diffs rather than the commit messages, which were authored by a session with context not available here.
acceptance_criteria: every one of the six commits is represented in CHANGELOG.md under a REQ id
rationale and residual gaps are recorded in .ai/project-context.md
each claim is verified against the diff rather than the commit message

legal.title: Establish licensing terms for arbiter
legal.description: pyproject.toml declares a proprietary licence but the repository carries no LICENSE file and no copyright notice so no terms are granted in writing. docs/licensing.md records the requirements the instrument must satisfy and the questions that block drafting it.
acceptance_criteria: a LICENSE file exists at the repository root and pyproject.toml references it
ownership of scan output is assigned to the user
the redistribution review for bundled analyzers is recorded in NOTICE.md with a date and a reviewer
risk_notes: Requires qualified legal review and cannot be completed by engineering alone
the air-gapped bundle roadmap item stays blocked until the semgrep LGPL-2.1 redistribution question is answered
